document.name: Glory MMA Kids Martial Arts
document.shortDescription: Woodside mixed martial arts program for ages 7-16 combining kickboxing, Muay Thai, and Brazilian jiu jitsu, with free trial sign-up.
document.longDescription:
Glory MMA's official kids page in Woodside describes a youth mixed martial arts program for children ages 7-16. The page says the gym combines kickboxing, Muay Thai, and Brazilian jiu jitsu in a system designed to be safe, fun, and easy to follow for young students.

The same page and footer identify the location as 45-35 47th Street, Woodside, NY 11377 with contact phone (718) 433-0544 and email info@glorymma.com. Glory's official schedule page publishes class-schedule business hours for the gym as Monday-Friday 11:00 AM-12:00 PM and 4:00 PM-9:30 PM, plus Saturday 10:00 AM-2:00 PM, which supports weekday and weekend availability for the studio's active programs.

The official kids page also promotes a free trial class for families who want to visit before committing. The listing image here is an ImgBB re-host of one of Glory MMA's own class photos from the kids program page.

Sources: https://www.glorymma.com/kidsmma https://www.glorymma.com/schedule https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5d9cc40eac7d08435cdef016/1678489050967-L4G3TJ7I51KPJWPJPYBB/20230310_171457.jpg
document.announcementDescription: The official kids page invites families to sign up for a free trial class at Glory MMA.
